name: camayoc_dora_change_steps
description: DORA lead time, decomposed per change (aegis-rb3): for each change MERGED in the window, its opened, first required-checks-green and merge times, from aegis:ChangeEvent. firstGreen is the literal "none" when no required-checks-green result was recorded. Reviews come from camayoc_dora_change_reviews and delivery from camayoc_dora_change_deployed; the reader joins the three on ?change and takes the differences. Only a green inside the change's lifecycle counts (at or after opening, at or before the merge); a green that first arrived after the merge is not a pre-merge green. Graph scope: camayoc window graphs, plus the one staged backfill graph named by {staging}; no other named graph is read.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(?openedAt) AS ?opened) (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?greenAt), "none")) AS ?firstGreen) (MIN(?mergedAt) AS ?merged) WHERE { GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gm), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gm = <{staging}>) && STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?go), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?go = <{staging}>)) } OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?gg { ?c a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "ci-passed" ; aegis:occurredAt ?greenAt . } FILTER((STRSTARTS(STR(?gg), "https://camayoc.local/window/") || ?gg = <{staging}>) && STR(?greenAt) <= STR(?mergedAt) && (!BOUND(?openedAt) || STR(?greenAt) >= STR(?openedAt))) } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?merged

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu

params.name: staging
params.description: exact IRI of the one reviewed staged-backfill graph read alongside the window graphs (aegis-rb3 B2); pass an IRI with no data, e.g. urn:quipu:import:staging:none, when there is none
